name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: a server's Kind (Jellyfin vs Plex) silently reset to Jellyfin on the very next unrelated config save. The main config page's Save form has no field for Kind - it's set once when a server is added - but the save endpoint's per-server preservation block (which already exists to protect fields like FederationId and IssuedApiKey from the same fate) never covered it, and the sanitized server shape returned to the UI never included it either, so there was no way to even see it get lost. Confirmed live: a freshly-added Plex server had its Kind wiped back to Jellyfin within the same session it was created in, which would have made the sync treat it as an ordinary (and non-functional) Jellyfin peer. Kind is now preserved across saves and included in the API response. 256 tests, all green.
